name: benchmark_crops_final
description: benchmark_crops_final is a labeled image dataset of agricultural crop instances intended to evaluate and benchmark computer vision models for crop recognition and classification. It includes images captured under varied conditions (lighting, scale, occlusion) to test model robustness in practical agricultural settings. The benchmark is primarily used to measure classification accuracy and to compare preprocessing and model architectures for crop identification.
reputation: A niche dataset with limited but practical use in agricultural and remote-sensing ML tasks.
